title: 1986 LEAF ALL STAR GAME DALE MURPHY ATLANTA BRAVES FOLD OUT POP UP FIGURE (A-G)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1986 oversized Leaf baseball sports trading card featuring Dale Murphy of the Atlanta Braves. It is from the All-Star Game set and includes a fold-out pop-up figure of the player. The card number is #75, and it was manufactured in 1986. This unique card showcases Murphy during the 1986 season and is a must-have for collectors.
